items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: he and I knew each other, we used to hang out together -- went to Atlantic City. He was a good friend, man.

ctx.x: When did you first meet Ike Quebec?

... The studio, Blue Note, arranged that we record together, but he and I knew each other, we used to hang out together -- went to Atlantic City. He was a good friend, man. We got things together and had a good session...
You did another date in 1944 with Coleman Hawkins. Did you know Coleman Hawkins well.
